name: Joseph Hoolihan

items.why: The item documents no foreign-government payments, FARA filings or foreign-agent donors, so there is no conduct by this person bearing on the foreign-ties criterion.

for_review: Item 1 says nothing was found, so it's a null finding, not a controversy. The sources I read describe Hoolihan as an NPA/independent candidate for House District 71, not a sitting state representative. Election-night results (Nov 3, 2026) show him with about 2% against Republican Jordan Varnadore, who won with about 54%, so he appears not to have won. The Ballot Buddy description should be checked. The owner-site search (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about him. I did not open the FARA or campaign-finance records directly. Transparency USA's summary lists tiny campaign finance totals: $50 in contributions and a $1,500 loan. I saw no foreign or big-money concerns, and I did not open the campaign-finance records directly.
